items.exampleEn: The owl blinked slowly at us from the branch.
items.exampleZh: 那隻貓頭鷹在樹枝上慢慢地對我們眨眼。

items.exampleEn: Hundreds of people joined a rally for cleaner rivers.
items.exampleZh: 數百人參加了一場爭取河川更乾淨的集會。

items.exampleEn: Use this table for the conversion of pounds into kilograms.
items.exampleZh: 用這張表把磅換算成公斤。

items.exampleEn: Workers used a small blast to break up the huge rock.
items.exampleZh: 工人用一次小規模的爆破把那塊巨石炸開。

items.exampleEn: Sparks flew when the worker cut the metal pipe.
items.exampleZh: 工人切割金屬管時，火花四濺。

items.exampleEn: Soak the beans in water overnight before you cook them.
items.exampleZh: 煮豆子之前，先把豆子泡在水裡一整晚。

items.exampleEn: She muttered an answer that nobody could hear.
items.exampleZh: 她喃喃地回答了一句，沒有人聽得見。

items.exampleEn: My sister uses a special tool to straighten her hair.
items.exampleZh: 我姊姊用一種特殊工具把頭髮弄直。

items.sentenceEn: Please straighten the chairs before you leave the room.
items.sentenceZh: 離開房間前，請把椅子排整齊。

items.audioEn: My little brother muttered that he was hungry, so we stopped at a small restaurant.
items.audioZh: 我弟弟咕噥著說他餓了，所以我們在一家小餐廳停下來。
items.questionZh: 他們為什麼在餐廳停下來？

items.sentenceEn: A sudden blast of wind blew my hat into the river.
items.sentenceZh: 一陣突如其來的強風把我的帽子吹進河裡。

items.sentenceEn: The heavy rain soaked my shoes on the way to school.
items.sentenceZh: 上學途中，大雨把我的鞋子淋得溼透。

items.stemEn: Dust got in my eyes and made me ____ again and again.
items.stemZh: 灰塵跑進我的眼睛，讓我一直眨眼。

items.stemEn: On a dry day, a single ____ can start a forest fire.
items.stemZh: 在乾燥的日子裡，一點火星就可能引發森林大火。

items.passageEn: The conversion of the old train station into a library took almost three years. When workers demolished the old walls, they had to be careful, because even a small spark could start a fire in the dry wood. In winter, a cold blast of wind blew through the empty building, and the workers would mutter about the weather. Now the library is warm and bright. On opening day, there was a small rally outside, where people cheered and sang for the new library.
items.passageZh: 把舊火車站改建成圖書館花了將近三年。工人拆除舊牆時必須很小心，因為就算是一點小火星，也可能讓乾燥的木頭起火。冬天時，一陣陣冷風吹過空蕩蕩的建築，工人們常會嘀咕天氣不好。現在圖書館溫暖又明亮。開幕當天，外面有一場小型集會，大家為新圖書館歡呼歌唱。

questions.questionZh: 工人拆舊牆時為什麼要小心？

referenceEn: He straightened his tie before the interview.
Before his interview, he straightened his tie.
rubricZh: 要用 straighten 當及物動詞（例如 straightened his tie）
時間片語可放句首或句尾，例如 before the interview 等
時態配合內容（例如 straightened、straightens 等）

items.promptZh: 我的手機有新訊息時，上面的小燈會一閃一閃的。
referenceEn: The little light on my phone blinks when I get a new message.
When I have a new message, the small light on my phone blinks.
rubricZh: blink 在這裡表示「（燈）閃爍」（例如 the light blinks、keeps blinking 等）
「有新訊息時」可寫，例如 when I get a new message、when I have a new message 等
動詞配合主詞（例如 blinks 等）

resolvedAfterFinalReview.resolution: 改前：["Her brother was hungry", "It started to rain", "Their car broke down", "They met a friend"]；改後：["The boy wanted food", "It started to rain", "Their car broke down", "The restaurant was empty"]

resolvedAfterFinalReview.message: 執行長第②③關裁示修正：第③關 A：FIX 27：裁示「評分要點不寫死時態」
resolvedAfterFinalReview.resolution: 改前："時態用過去式（例如 straightened）"；改後："時態配合內容（例如 straightened、straightens 等）"

resolvedAfterFinalReview.resolution: 改前："The longest rally of the match lasted forty shots."；改後："Hundreds of people joined a rally for cleaner rivers."

resolvedAfterFinalReview.resolution: 改前："這場比賽最長的一次來回對打持續了四十拍。"；改後："數百人參加了一場爭取河川更乾淨的集會。"

resolvedAfterFinalReview.message: 第②關 issue 結案：音檔是說話者說「My little brother」，說話者性別不明，選項「Her brother was hungry」擅自假定說話者是女性；建議改 The speaker's brother was hungry。
resolvedAfterFinalReview.resolution: 已修正：見本檔 resolvedAfterFinalReview 中 items/9 的修正紀錄。
